rows.name: Production station and prop kit

active_visual_holds.reason: The 2026-09-26 post-completion audit, exact historical source-bound evidence and user-approved references confirm that multiple T05 station/resource/prop families remain visually primitive/blockout-like despite being authored GLBs.

findings.detail: Hearth/furnace, counters, processing fixtures, defense platform, resource stacks and pads are generated primarily from generic boxes/cylinders/related forms and do not meet the sculpted shipping-art bar.
Wood/stone/metal/fuel/fish/food/money/crate families must be rebuilt as resource-specific authored silhouettes such as rope-bound logs, faceted ore/crystal, framed bins and physical bundled currency.
Ground pads currently read as flat world-space UI tokens and must become shallow constructed camp platforms while preserving six purposes, footprints and sockets.

active_visual_holds.required_resolution: Re-author T05 visible station/prop families on the exact authorized repair branch while preserving IDs, sockets, footprints, clearances, arrangements and all gameplay contracts. Require source-bound multi-angle/gameplay/native-4K evidence, zero primitive-looking/blockout findings, exact 10/10 locked style dimensions where required by the global reference-style policy, and explicit user visual approval before clearing the invalidation.
active_visual_holds.latest_user_direction: Use the newly approved sculpted winter-production asset language; authored meshes that still visually read as primitive/blockout geometry fail. Preserve T05 mechanics/sockets/layout contracts.
active_visual_holds.generator_root_cause: The historical deterministic T05 generator builds much of the final visible kit from generic beveled_box/cylinder/sphere/lathe forms. These are custom-authored GLBs, but exact source-bound renders still read as blockout-like compared with the approved art language.

thick irregular snow accumulation integrated into silhouettes
faceted stone, ore and crystal resources with snow contact
rope-bound logs with bark and readable cut ends
framed resource bins and storage platforms
physical constructed camp pads and tiles instead of flat UI-like tokens
